metadata.title: Stir Fried Potatoes with Bamboo Shoot
metadata.description:
A vey simple potato fries recipe with a Northeastern twist. Potatoes are stir fried with fermented bamboo shoot to give it a slight tang and that lovely aroma that the bamboo shoot has. 

Ingredients

Potatoes - 2 medium sized
Onion - 1 medium sized
Dry red chilies -  2-3
Bamboo Shoots - 2 tablespoon or as required
Cooking oil - 2 tablespoon
Cumin seeds - 1 teaspoon
Chili Powder - 1 teaspoon
Turmeric - 1 teaspoon
Salt as required
